brief: Killing my $5K/mo agency retainer with a Claude Code BD agent. 3 tools, one prompt.

slots.step1Title: Five grand monthly for stale lists
slots.step1Sub: I paid $5K for spreadsheets I never used.
slots.step2Title: Three day delays killed my sales velocity
slots.step2Sub: Waiting on freelancers killed all our momentum.
slots.step3Title: Output quality dropped every single quarter
slots.step3Sub: The ROI kept shrinking while excuses grew.

slots.step1Title: One prompt runs the entire outbound stack
slots.step1Sub: Claude orchestrates all three tools automatically.
slots.step2Title: Apollo builds hyper targeted lead lists daily
slots.step2Sub: It pulls prospects that match our ICP exactly.
slots.step3Title: Hunter enriches emails then Make fires sequences
slots.step3Sub: No manual exports or CSV juggling required.

slots.step1Title: Query Apollo by title and company size
slots.step1Sub: It returns fifty fresh prospects in under a minute.
slots.step2Title: Filter by size and recent hiring signals
slots.step2Sub: We only target Series A startups with open roles.
slots.step3Title: Export clean JSON into the next tool
slots.step3Sub: No messy CSVs or manual copy paste needed.

slots.step1Title: Feed Apollo URLs into Hunter via API
slots.step1Sub: Claude writes the Python script on the fly.
slots.step2Title: Match confidence scores to keep deliverability high
slots.step2Sub: We only keep emails rated eighty percent or higher.
slots.step3Title: Verify in bulk to protect domain health
slots.step3Sub: Bounce rates dropped to nearly zero overnight.

slots.step1Title: Connect Hunter output to Make webhook instantly
slots.step1Sub: Claude generates the JSON payload correctly every time.
slots.step2Title: Map variables to personalized email templates
slots.step2Sub: Each message references real company pain points.
slots.step3Title: Schedule follow ups without touching the inbox
slots.step3Sub: The sequence runs while I sleep or close deals.

slots.step1Title: Paste the system prompt into Claude Code
slots.step1Sub: It remembers the entire workflow context forever.
slots.step2Title: Type natural commands like run today's list
slots.step2Sub: Claude handles Apollo Hunter and Make automatically.
slots.step3Title: Scale to thousands of leads for free
slots.step3Sub: I reinvested that five grand into paid ads instead.

slots.body: I turned one prompt and three tools into a $5K agency replacement. Comment below and I'll ship you the breakdown.
